**Biolab Disaster** for the Sony PlayStation: a port of [phoboslab's Biolab Disaster](https://github.com/phoboslab/high_biolab), released with permission of Dominic Szablewski.

## New in 1.1
- **Random Level mode**: choose it on the title screen (Up/Down). It plays endless generated levels from a seed you can see, change (Left/Right) and share. A new random seed is picked with Square. Levels start at 160 tiles and grow by one screen per completed level, up to 1024 tiles, with more enemies as you go. Every generated level is checked to be completable.
- The stats screen shows the random level number and seed.

## Downloads
- **BiolabDisasterPSX-v1.1-disc.zip**: bootable disc image (`biolab.bin` + `biolab.cue`) with the original *Biochemie* soundtrack as a CD audio track. Open the `.cue` in DuckStation, ePSXe, Mednafen or RetroArch, or burn it to a CD-R.
- **BIOLAB.EXE**: the program on its own, for emulators that load PS-EXE files directly. No music, since that lives on the CD.

## Features
- All 3 original levels in full color, at a steady 60 fps
- Original music at CD quality, all sound effects, real translucency and additive glow effects

## Controls
D-pad: move · Cross (or Up): jump · Square or Circle: shoot · START: start/continue
On the title screen, Up/Down picks Story Mode or Random Level, Left/Right changes the seed and Square picks a new random seed.

## Notes
On a real PlayStation the disc needs a modchip or a softmod (e.g. FreePSXBoot, Unirom). Emulators boot it directly.

## Credits
Game, graphics and code: Dominic Szablewski · Music: Andreas Loesch · PlayStation port built with PSn00bSDK
